tasks.dts: deno task types && deno run -A npm:dts-bundle-generator@9 -o mod.d.ts --project tsconfig.bundle.json --no-check types/mod.d.ts && deno run --allow-read=mod.d.ts --allow-write=mod.d.ts scripts/fix-phaser-dts.ts
tasks.dts:check: deno task dts && git diff --exit-code mod.d.ts
tasks.fmt: deno fmt mod.js src/ docs/ examples/starter/ README.md deno.json
tasks.fmt:check: deno fmt --check mod.js src/ docs/ examples/starter/ README.md deno.json
tasks.ci: deno task lint && deno task fmt:check && deno task check && deno task dts:check && deno task test
tasks.starter:build: deno run -A npm:vite@8.0.8 build --config examples/starter/vite.config.js examples/starter
tasks.starter:preview: deno run -A npm:vite@8.0.8 preview --config examples/starter/vite.config.js examples/starter
